titulo.alumno: Describing symptoms with duration and frequency

intro: In this lesson you will practice describing symptoms with duration and frequency.

frases.estudio: Έχω βήχα εδώ και τρεις ημέρες και κοιμάμαι άσχημα τη νύχτα.
frases.alumno: I've had a cough for three days and I sleep badly at night.

frases.estudio: Μπορείτε να μου εξηγήσετε πότε πρέπει να πάρω αυτό το φάρμακο;
frases.alumno: Can you explain to me when I should take this medicine?

frases.estudio: Πάρτε το χάπι μετά το φαγητό και πιείτε αρκετό νερό.
frases.alumno: Take the pill after eating and drink plenty of water.

texto: Describe how long and how often the symptoms occur; check how and when to follow an instruction.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the explanation and select the correct instruction or duration.
